text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein decorates senior army commanders who took part in Baghdad's military operation in northern Iraq in late August.
- National Assembly hosts education minister to speak about the reality of Iraq's education sector.
(The above stories were carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA0
- Preparations are underway to receive Turkish trucks loaded with goods for Iraq.
- President Saddam Hussein congratulates leaders of Oman and Morocco on their national days.
